author: Chris Ogden
releaseNotes:
1.6.6 - Code confirmations ignore letter case, and more secret fields are removed from events.
1.6.5 - Select all and Clear buttons for the lock code management and full lock control lists.
1.6.4 - Booking codes are protected regardless of letter case.
1.6.3 - Replacing the fingerprint key now requires approval on the hub.
1.6.2 - Reconnect fixes; turning lock code management off always clears its settings.
1.6.1 - Hub report fixes.
1.6.0 - Daily hub report: app versions, slot settings, hub firmware and uptime, and lock health (never codes). Click Done once after updating to send the first report right away.
1.5.3 - Reconnect follow-ups.
1.5.2 - One-click Reconnect with a 10-minute sign-in link, also while lock code management is on.
1.5.1 - Clearer confirmation page after Connect or Reconnect.
1.5.0 - Lock code management: custom code names and full lock control, per lock and opt-in on the hub.
1.4.1 - Lock code management: error messages and logs never contain door codes.
1.4.0 - Lock code management: SignalBricks can rename or move a code on the hub without having the code.
1.3.5 - New optional, off-by-default setting to include door codes, which SignalBricks keeps only as a keyed hash.
1.3.4 - The app page shows the name with the version; tighter protection of booking codes.
1.3.3 - Lock code management: read fingerprints for all locks in one request.
1.3.2 - Daily check-in, so a quiet hub reports a new version within a day.
1.3.1 - Re-registers with SignalBricks by itself after an update.
1.3.0 - Lock code management: code fingerprints so SignalBricks can group matching codes without reading them.
1.2.1 - Fixes a registration error on hubs connected before lock code management existed.
1.2.0 - Lock code management: the hub verifies and retries each code change and reports the result.
1.1.1 - Lock code management: tighter protection of booking codes, and locks not yet onboarded are read-only.
1.1.0 - Optional lock code management (off by default) for admin and managed codes on locks you select.
1.0.0 - Initial release: read-only lock and sensor telemetry, Connect with OAuth, door codes stripped from events.
